## Problem Statement

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe it clearly without immediately jumping to a solution.

## Proposed Solution

What would you like to see added or changed? Be as specific as possible about behavior, UI, or API shape.

## Alternatives Considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why you prefer the proposed solution.

## Relevant Context

- Does this exist in FunLearn V1? If so, how did it work there?
- Which part of the codebase is most likely affected (e.g., a specific Fragment, ViewModel, repository)?
- Any relevant screenshots, mockups, or references.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and this is not a duplicate.
- [ ] I understand this is a solo-maintained project and feature scope is limited.
